C45232.observed: What was checked: that "Split across bins…" opens the right window for the kind of user clicking it, since a technician and a service writer need different things. What happened: signed in as the technician it opens the "Bin Locations" window - just the bins, their stock and how much to take from each. Signed in as an administrator, who can see pricing, the same action instead opens the full "New Part Request" window, which carries the part number, description, source, category, vendor, cost, core charge, sell price and margin, and shows the bins inside it. So each user gets the window that suits what they are allowed to see.
C45232.not_observed: The middle case - a Full View user WITHOUT the "See Financial Data" permission, who should get the Bin Locations window like the technician - could not be tested: a role change cannot be saved on this branch (see the note with C53477), so that user cannot be created here.

C45235.observed: What was checked: how a bin that is already in the red is shown, and whether it stops you taking from it. What happened: a part whose bin already stands at minus 1 was chosen. In the "Bin Locations" window that bin's stock figure is printed in red, on its own - every other figure and heading in the window is black or grey - so it stands out without any hunting. It does not block anything: the window still shows "Allocated 1 — the row quantity will be set to 1" and Apply is available, so the work can go ahead with the shortfall visible.
